violations.description: Cleaning and maintenance of floors, walls and ceilings. — --Physical facilities (e.g. floors, walls, ceiling etc…) were not clean or not cleaned as often as necessary to keep them clean. Grease on floor from fryer.

General equipment and utensils - Materials and design. — --Material of nonfood contact surface was not constructed or designed to be smooth, nonabsorbent and cleanable. observed duct tape on the warmer.
Handwashing lavatories. — --Handwashing lavatory was used for purpose other than handwashing. Hand sink was blocked at time of inspection.
